channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Plano de Flávio propõe impedir parentes de ministros de advogar no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan proposes banning relatives up to the third degree of STF and other superior court ministers from practicing law before the Supreme Court, expanding the current rule that only disqualifies judges from hearing cases involving their relatives. The plan also seeks to limit monocratic decisions at the STF, favor collegial rulings, presume the constitutionality of legislative processes, and remove the Court's criminal jurisdiction, restricting it to its original constitutional duties.

item.title: O homem por trás da crise entre Brasil e Estados Unidos - O Assunto #1782
item.description: The U.S. State Department's video asserting American dominance in the Americas, invoking the Monroe Doctrine, sparked a diplomatic crisis with Brazil, including the revocation of the visa of Brazilian ambassador Maria Luísa Viotti. Marco Rubio, Secretary of State and Trump's national security advisor, is portrayed as an ideological Republican who has declared 'this is our hemisphere' and is viewed as hostile to the Lula government. Political scientist Carlos Gustavo Poggio warns of the risk of Rubio's interference in Brazil's October 2026 elections.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Guia do Eleitor
item.description: The voter guide for the 2026 elections outlines the first round on October 4, with voting from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Brasília time nationwide. It details ID requirements (including e-Title), how to find polling places, rules on prohibited items like phones in voting booths, absentee and justified voting, penalties for not voting, and procedures to report electoral irregularities. It also covers dress code, cellphone use, and electoral crime prevention.

item.title: Ministros do TSE se reúnem nesta quinta e avaliam proibição do uso de deepfake na campanha eleitoral
item.description: TSE ministers are meeting this Thursday to discuss a potential ban on deepfake use in the 2026 electoral campaigns, weighing whether the prohibition should be absolute or limited to cases of voter deception or candidate harm. The meeting follows a PT-led action against an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro shown at the convention that nominated Flávio Bolsonaro as the PL’s presidential candidate. The goal is to prevent a flood of legal challenges and establish clear penalties, ranging from fines and warnings to stricter sanctions for repeat offenders.

item.title: Caiado diz que currículo de Flávio Bolsonaro é a certidão de nascimento
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) resume, claiming it amounts only to a birth certificate after UFRJ denied the senator completed a postgraduate degree in Political Sciences. Caiado also accused Flávio and Lula of being 'cowards and yellow-bellied' if they avoid presidential debates, intensifying his attacks on the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Quilombola de Pernambuco vota em quem conhece: Lula e prefeito de centro-direita
item.description: In a quilombola community in Salgueiro, Pernambuco, voters prioritize candidates they know and who have local presence, such as President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the city's center-right mayor, reflecting a vote based on personal trust and recognition of management, rather than party ideology. The report highlights how limited access and dispersed housing in the rural zone shape voting practices grounded in direct relationships and lived experience with candidates.

item.title: Kassio é criticado no TSE por supostos acenos a Flávio Bolsonaro; ministro nega
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques faced criticism for allegedly signaling support for arguments made by Flávio Bolsonaro's defense during the pre-campaign, raising concerns about his impartiality. The minister denied the allegations and stated he is seeking adjustments to avoid damage to his position in the court.

item.title: PT rebate defesa de Flávio Bolsonaro e diz ao TSE que vídeo de IA de Jair é irregular
item.description: The PT rebutted Flávio Bolsonaro's defense before the TSE, arguing that deepfake use is unlawful regardless of intent or authorization, citing Resolution No. 23.732/2024 which prohibits synthetic content in electoral campaigns. The party stated that the TSE has made clear that deepfake use may lead to registration or mandate cancellation, and that Bolsonaro's legal team ignores the distinction between deepfakes and generative AI, a distinction previously rejected by the Court.

item.title: Alcolumbre quer apoio de Lula para se manter no comando do Senado, e governo cobra avanço da 6x1
item.description: The Lula government is pressuring Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) to bring to vote a PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule. The goal is to secure PT’s support for Alcolumbre’s re-election as Senate president amid tensions between branches of government. This negotiation could determine the government’s political backing for the Senate leader.

item.title: Zema diz que vai obrigar ‘homens saudáveis com idade de trabalhar’ a aceitar proposta de emprego
item.description: Former Minas Gerais governor Romeu Zema (Novo) proposes requiring 'healthy men of working age' to accept job offers as a condition to maintain Bolsa Família, criticizing the use of aid for gambling by homeless individuals. His plan includes the Casas da Cidadania program offering vocational training, housing access, and a R$ 5,000 bonus for families leaving the program due to income growth, alongside facilitating the removal of makeshift shelters in public spaces.

item.title: O cenário de ‘terra arrasada’ em estado termômetro da eleição presidencial
item.description: Minas Gerais is experiencing a 'scorched earth' scenario in the gubernatorial race, marked by the absence of strong PT and PL candidacies, reflecting a broader political fragility. Columnist Robson Bonin argues that Romeu Zema’s governance, rooted in the 'denial of politics' and avoidance of traditional alliances, left the state without a party structure to sustain his project, undermining succession. Zema-backed candidate Mateus Simões lacks name recognition and fails to replicate the anti-system appeal of Cleitinho Azevedo, who leads in polls with a punitive discourse against the political establishment.

item.title: Tarcísio afirma que vídeo antivacina de Eduardo Bolsonaro não atrapalhou campanha contra sarampo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that Eduardo Bolsonaro's anti-vaccine video did not hinder the measles vaccination campaign in São Paulo, emphasizing public awareness about vaccines. He also acknowledged changing his stance on police body cameras, admitting they benefit both society and law enforcement after initially being critical.

item.title: O novo trocadilho do PT para associar Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro
item.description: PT communications chief Éden Valadares launched a social media campaign to promote the pun 'Fláviorcaro', linking presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to businessman Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master. This follows an earlier PT effort to associate Bolsonaro with the term 'TariFlávio' due to Trump-era tariffs on Brazilian goods. The move is part of the broader narrative battle between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Senado aprova alívio de imposto sobre combustíveis; texto vai à sanção
item.description: The Senate approved PLP 114/2026, which reduces federal taxes on fossil and renewable fuels, including ethanol, biodiesel, and aviation kerosene, to mitigate the impact of the U.S.-Iran war on oil prices. The measure also includes tax benefits for sectors such as ethanol production, fertilizers, critical minerals, and FIFA, with revenue losses offset by surging oil royalties, which grew over 200% in real terms from January to March 2026. The bill now awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: O que há por trás da reaproximação de Lula e Davi Alcolumbre
item.description: Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre resumed dialogue after the STF nomination crisis involving Jorge Messias, focusing on priority agendas such as the 6×1 workweek PEC, the 'shirt tax' MP, and the Public Security PEC, despite lingering distrust. According to columnist Robson Bonin, the rapprochement is driven by the need to pass legislation before provisional measures expire and the 2026 electoral calendar, with both sides choosing to bypass past conflicts to advance shared interests.

item.title: Justiça manda remover imagem que associa Raquel Lyra a Flávio Bolsonaro e aponta uso de IA
item.description: The Pernambuco Regional Electoral Court ordered the removal of a post falsely associating Governor Raquel Lyra with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, using an AI-generated image without labeling, characterizing it as negative anticipatory propaganda and disinformation. The ruling states the meeting never occurred and requires the profile administrator to be identified and formally included in the case, with a daily fine of BRL 10,000 for non-compliance.

item.title: Após encontro com Lula, Davi diz que ‘diálogo foi restabelecido’
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre said dialogue with President Lula has been restored following a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, emphasizing the importance of institutional relations for democracy. Government Leader in the Senate, Teresa Leitão, added that the relationship between the branches is now 'unblocked' and the climate is favorable to advance priority agendas.

item.title: PGR pede que STF mantenha proibição de visitas de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged the STF to maintain restrictions on visits from Flávio Bolsonaro to Jair Bolsonaro during his house arrest, stating that humanitarian detention does not nullify closed-regime rules and that limitations are justified due to non-compliance with Court-imposed conditions. The restrictions were initially imposed after Flávio shared a letter from Jair requesting votes for his candidacy and later extended to ban all visits with political-electoral purposes until the end of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Policial Edjane registra candidatura ao governo de São Paulo e não declara possuir bens
item.description: Police officer Edjane Lima de Sousa, candidate for governor of São Paulo from the Agir party, had her candidacy registered with the TSE on March 12 without declaring assets, despite having reported R$ 480 thousand in wealth during the 2022 municipal elections. Her running mate, Renata Bolsonaro, also failed to declare assets, as she did in her 2022 city council bid in Jaboticabal. Edjane is running in her fourth consecutive election under a fourth different party since 2020, having previously run for PTB, PROS, and PL, always finishing as an alternate.

item.title: A posição da PGR sobre visitas de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro na prisão domiciliar
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet supported maintaining the ban on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, after Flávio shared a letter received during a visit, violating the prohibition on using third parties for social media posts. The measure, initially imposed by Justice Alexandre de Moraes for 90 days, was backed by the PGR, which deemed the breach of prison conditions justified the sanction. Bolsonaro’s defense argued Flávio, as his lawyer, has visitation rights, but the PGR rejected this, stating the act constituted illegal use of third parties to circumvent judicial restrictions.

item.title: Deputado petista denuncia suposto favorecimento a amigo de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) denounced alleged favoritism by Rio de Janeiro's Superintendence of Patrimony of the Union (SUP) toward lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, in the dispute over a mansion located in a naval area currently occupied by Tottenham player Richarlison. According to Correia, documents obtained via the Access to Information Law show that Tomaz’s request, made in May 2022, was approved in July 2022, while Richarlison’s request from September 2021 was never reviewed. He claims that then-SUP-RJ superintendent Colonel Paulo da Silva Medeiros signed the documents that facilitated the acquisition of the property by Tomaz and Bolsonaro.

item.title: Veterinário Wilson Grassi registra candidatura à Presidência e declara patrimônio de R$ 50 milhões
item.description: Veterinarian Wilson Grassi (Democrat) filed his candidacy for President of Brazil with the TSE, declaring R$50 million in real estate assets. He previously ran for state deputy in 2006, federal deputy in 2022 (deemed ineligible), and city councilor in 2024. His platform proposes tax reforms, organized crime crackdowns, and strengthened border security.

item.title: Gonet defende manter suspensas visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet urged the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to maintain the 90-day suspension of visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to former President Jair Bolsonaro, citing Bolsonaro’s violation of house arrest conditions by delivering a letter to his son during a visit, which was later read in a social media live. Gonet argued that familial ties do not exempt Flávio from judicial restrictions and advocated for banning politically motivated visits until the end of the election period.

item.title: Fernando Haddad registra candidatura ao governo de SP e declara R$ 861 mil ao TSE
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) registered his candidacy for governor of São Paulo with Márcio França (PSB) as his running mate, declaring assets of R$ 861,2 thousand to the TSE. He previously ran for the same office in 2022, securing 45% of valid votes in the runoff against Tarcísio de Freitas. In a press briefing, Haddad alleged his driver was targeted by a military police patrol and urged an investigation, which the state Secretariat of Public Security confirmed it is pursuing.

item.title: PGR defende a rejeição de recursos apresentados por defesa de Bolsonaro contra a restrição de visitas
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) supported Justice Alexandre de Moraes in rejecting Bolsonaro's defense appeals to overturn the ban on visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to his father, who is under house arrest. The PGR argued that the senator violated the terms of the humanitarian measure by sharing a handwritten letter from Jair Bolsonaro on social media, constituting an abuse of visitation rights and breach of the social media prohibition. The visit suspension, lasting 90 days, remains in effect throughout the 2026 electoral campaign.

item.title: Flávio propõe manter programas do PT, Caixa Federal repaginada e foco em terras raras e data centers
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) proposes maintaining existing PT social programs with improved management and fraud prevention, linking benefits to first employment and professional training. His plan includes reviving the Casa Verde e Amarela program to build 2.5 million homes, prioritizing property titles in women's names, and leveraging Caixa Econômica Federal as a tool for social mobility through credit, financial advice, and entrepreneurship support, while focusing on critical minerals and data centers.

item.title: Modernização das regras nos conflitos entre contribuinte e Fisco vai à sanção
item.description: The Senate plenary approved a bill to modernize the National Tax Code, establishing new paths — transaction, mediation, and arbitration — to resolve tax disputes between the government and taxpayers without judicialization. The proposal includes progressive fines discounts for voluntary debt regularization and requires the Public Treasury to act within 90 days after a favorable court ruling for taxpayers. Approved unanimously with 69 votes, the bill now awaits presidential sanction.

item.title: Há um esforço coordenado em manter as coisas como estão e Lula no Planalto
item.description: There is a coordinated effort between sectors of the STF and congressional leaders to keep Lula in power, not merely as a convenience alliance but to preserve the institutional status quo. Congress and the Judiciary see Lula as a stabilizing factor that avoids direct confrontation, despite existing tensions between the branches. The 2026 election is viewed as uncertain due to late-deciding voters and a widespread climate of discouragement, distrust, and hopelessness, making the outcome highly susceptible to last-minute imponderables.

item.title: Quem está na frente para presidente? O que dizem pesquisas da última semana
item.description: Recent polls show Lula (PT) leading Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the first-round scenario for the 2026 presidential election. While the percentage gaps vary across surveys, the trend indicates an advantage for the incumbent president. Second-round scenarios were also examined, yielding divergent results depending on the opponent.

item.title: Moraes arquiva ação contra funcionários da Havan por atos antidemocráticos
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes dismissed an investigation into Havan employees over alleged involvement in anti-democratic acts in Rio do Sul (SC) following Lula’s 2022 election victory. The ruling cites insufficient evidence to proceed with the case.

item.title: Quem é Conor Kennedy, marido de Giulia Be que pode ser preso na Rússia
item.description: John Conor Kennedy, husband of Brazilian singer Giulia Be and an attorney, may be arrested in Russia after its justice system authorized his detention on allegations of serving as a mercenary alongside Ukrainian armed forces. He is the son of Robert F. Kennedy Jr., U.S. Secretary of Health, and a grandnephew of John F. Kennedy. The couple married in a private ceremony in Los Angeles in March 2026, with guest lists reportedly including Donald Trump and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Renan Santos ironiza erro no currículo de Flávio
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Mission to the Presidency, mocked the error in Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) resume, which lists Law at USP without completing the course. He pointed out that Flávio's supporters tried to diminish him over his education, yet Flávio's own official resume contains a similar inaccuracy. The comment was made in a press release sent on Wednesday, the 12th.

item.title: Tarcísio rebate fala de Haddad sobre presença de traficante em palco
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas's campaign countered Fernando Haddad's accusation that he lied about Haddad sharing a stage with a drug trafficking leader, releasing photos from a June 2025 event showing Alessandra Moja Cunha, sister of a PCC leader, on stage alongside Haddad — though no interaction between them was recorded. Haddad had claimed he did not know her and that Tarcísio should have arrested her if he knew of her criminal ties.

item.title: Governo Tarcísio aciona STF contra Lula
item.description: The São Paulo state government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, filed a lawsuit at the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to pressure the federal government into approving a federal guarantee for a R$5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil. The state’s Attorney General, Inês Coimbra, claims the Ministry of Finance has taken over 70 days to respond, constituting administrative omission. The move aims to secure funding for state investments, escalating tensions between the state and federal administrations.

item.title: Governo Lula rebate gestão Tarcísio e diz que aval de operações ao Estado supera histórico
item.description: The Lula government pushed back against Tarcísio de Freitas' claims of delay in approving São Paulo's R$ 5.4 billion loan guarantee, stating that the annual average of guarantees granted between 2023 and 2026 exceeds the state's historical average with the Union by more than three times. The Finance Ministry emphasized that the process follows standard procedures, with equal fiscal and legal compatibility reviews for all entities, and that the request, initiated in November 2025, has involved multiple exchanges for document completion. It noted that despite higher demand during electoral periods, the operation remains within usual timelines and is in the final stage of processing.

item.title: Bruno Guimarães faz de pênalti pelo Arsenal após eliminação do Brasil
item.description: Bruno Guimarães scored his first goal for Arsenal by converting a penalty in a friendly against Como, following his missed penalty in Brazil's World Cup elimination against Norway. Coming on as a substitute, he calmly slotted the third penalty for Arsenal, helping them win 4-3 on penalties. The goal was hailed as a personal and symbolic redemption after his earlier disappointment with the national team.

item.title: Gleisi defende Janja após deputada do PL acionar MPF por caso Discord
item.description: Federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann (PT-PR) defended First Lady Janja Lula da Silva after deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) filed a complaint with the Federal Public Ministry (MPF) over Janja's stance on the Discord case. Gleisi criticized Zanatta's action, saying she is attacking those trying to prevent crimes against children, and stressed that platforms must comply with Brazilian child protection laws. The ANPD had ordered the suspension of live streams on Discord following the death of a 13-year-old girl on the platform.

item.title: Pool de emissoras das Eleições 2026 começa a funcionar em 24 de agosto
item.description: Starting August 24, the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will activate the broadcaster pool for the 2026 General Elections, responsible for receiving media materials and generating the signal for free electoral propaganda. Service will be available from 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. in room 501, 5th floor, at the TSE headquarters in Brasília, with detailed information published on the TSE portal on the same date.

item.title: Vídeo mostra viatura da PM passando por carro de Haddad enquanto ministro entra em casa; assista
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the PT candidate for governor of São Paulo, reported being subjected to an irregular police approach by a Military Police vehicle on Tuesday night, 11, as he arrived at his home in the Planalto Paulista area. He stated that the police car pulled alongside and trailed his vehicle closely, and that his driver was followed after he entered the residence. The São Paulo Public Security Secretariat has launched a preliminary investigation, linking the incident to a separate arrest of theft suspects in another area, though Haddad maintained he was the target of persecution.

item.title: “O diálogo foi restabelecido”, diz Alcolumbre sobre trégua com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) said dialogue with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has been restored following their meeting on Wednesday, the 12th. He stated they did not discuss any past STF nomination, saying 'we didn't talk about the past'. The two had been estranged since the Senate rejected a Supreme Court nomination during the previous administration.

item.title: Lula assina decreto que abre mercado livre de energia para consumidores residenciais e pequenos estabelecimentos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva signed a decree opening the free electricity market to low-voltage consumers, starting with small businesses in November 2027 and extending to residential consumers in November 2028. The measure aims to reduce electricity bills by up to 20% for small establishments and establishes a Supplier of Last Resort (SUI) to ensure supply continuity until 2030, after which other entities may assume the role under Aneel regulation. Lula also signed decrees on sustainable aviation fuel, low-emission hydrogen, and carbon capture and storage.

item.title: Governo aproveita texto que amplia gastos em 2026 para sinalizar ajuste nas contas em 2027
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved changes to fiscal rules allowing the Lula government to increase spending in 2026, an election year, while promising to contain expenses in 2027. The adjustment seeks to balance electoral stimulus needs with future fiscal responsibility.

item.title: Totalização dos votos é aberta, auditável e segura, diz TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) states that the vote tallying process for the 2026 elections is open, auditable, and secure, with voting beginning at individual polling stations, generation of ballot bulletins, encrypted transmission of data, and authenticity checks before results are consolidated. Parties, candidates, and overseers can monitor all stages, and the system allows for recounts and post-election audits, preserving ballots and digital records. Printed voting was deemed unconstitutional by the STF, and biometrics serve as an additional security layer to verify voter identity.

item.title: Plano de Flávio Bolsonaro deve propor mudanças no funcionamento do STF. Veja quais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) preliminary government plan proposes reforms to the functioning of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), including ending privileged jurisdiction for authorities, limiting individual ministers' monocratic decisions, and imposing a one-year quarantine for former ministers and state secretaries before being appointed to the Court. These changes require congressional approval and reflect a long-standing opposition agenda, amplified by 2025 protests against the arrest of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Governo de SP entra com recurso no STF para destravar empréstimo federal de R$ 5,4 bi para obras
item.description: The São Paulo state government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, filed a petition with the STF to compel the Federal Ministry of Finance to release a R$ 5.45 billion loan from Banco do Brasil for infrastructure and mobility projects. The issue has become politicized, with Flávio Bolsonaro leveraging it to criticize the federal government, intensifying tensions between state and federal authorities.

item.title: MDB fecha apoio à PEC e pressiona Alcolumbre a despachar 6x1
item.description: The MDB Senate bloc unanimously urged that the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule be processed urgently, increasing pressure on Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. The bloc considers the proposal, stalled since May, one of its three top priorities — alongside the Public Security PEC and the legal framework for critical minerals — all delayed due to tensions between Alcolumbre and President Lula. Leader Eduardo Braga stated the MDB supports urgent processing via the CCJ to accelerate deliberation.

item.title: Lula pede a Alcolumbre que faça ‘o possível e o impossível’ para votar o fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to do 'everything possible and impossible' to approve the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, passed by the Chamber in May but stalled in the Senate. Although acknowledging the vote is unlikely before the October elections, Lula renewed his confidence in Alcolumbre after over three months of estrangement, seeking his support for Lula’s 2026 reelection and public endorsement to counter Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy.

item.title: Após terremoto, Brasil atende a pedido da Colômbia e anuncia envio de ajuda humanitária ao país
item.description: Brazil announced the dispatch of humanitarian aid to Colombia following a 7.4-magnitude earthquake that left over 200 dead. The decision came after talks between Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira and his Colombian counterpart Omar Escobar, with the Itamaraty confirming the aid. President Lula also expressed solidarity and offered full government support for rescue and recovery operations.

item.title: Lula e Alcolumbre não conversaram sobre Messias, diz ministro
item.description: In the meeting between President Lula and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre on Wednesday (August 12), the possible re-nomination of Attorney General Jorge Messias to the STF was not discussed, as confirmed by Minister José Guimarães. The meeting focused on advancing government priorities in the Senate, including the Public Security PEC and the end of the 6×1 work scale, as well as the MP to eliminate the 'blusinhas' tax. Lula intends to discuss the Messias matter only in a private conversation with Alcolumbre at a later time.

item.title: Comissão inicia análise de redução da maioridade penal sob questionamento de constitucionalidade
item.description: The Special Committee of the Chamber of Deputies elected Deputy Aluisio Mendes (Republicanos-MA) as president and Mendonça Filho (PL-PE) as rapporteur to analyze proposals for reducing the age of criminal responsibility, including PECs establishing full civil and criminal majority at age 16. The rapporteur presented a work plan with five thematic axes and a timeline aiming for a vote in the committee and plenary by December 2026, following the 2028 municipal elections as a potential reference for a popular referendum.
